description: We are Spaceshift Mission. A team driven by passion, discovering, & finding new innovations for space exploration and more. We aim to advance astronomical technology and have students (like us) more active in space exploration through NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
summary: We were a well-equipped team of five; of course, we faced many challenges while developing the project. In fact, while coding the AI, I almost dropped it from the project because it didn’t work for a long time. I barely slept at all during the project—I just managed to catch a few quick naps here and there. Afterward, our mentor was a huge help, and thanks to him, we were able to steer the project in this direction. Beyond that, being with my teammates made this competition a lot of fun—especially the combination of having fun and working hard. Without them, this project would never have come to fruition.
details: With our game Hard Space, we aim to help children ages 7 to 12 transform their uncertain and daunting view of space into a more fun and clear perspective by using their own imagination. Our game is based on the RPG (role-playing game) concept and generally progresses through a question-and-answer format, In addition, it includes many other features, such as random events and special interactive activities. Each play session in our game is unique because it incorporates the power of artificial intelligence, creating a different path and story in every playthrough. Furthermore, a random event called the “Film Set” occurs with a certain probability, and when it does, an Easter egg is unlocked, revealing a narrative that unfolds before you. Experiencing this is incredibly exciting. Aside from these elements, the game features a scoring system at the end, which fosters friendly competition among players and encourages them to develop more strategic approaches.
